data.reasoning: Report 1's inconclusive verdict is due to an API error (HTTP 400) when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD, which carries no verdict signal per the instructions. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by a tool error in Report 1 (qwen3-235b-a22b-2507), which failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. Report 2 (deepseek-v4-flash) successfully audited the PKGBUILD and found it safe. The disagreement is not based on differing interpretations of the code, but rather on a failure to complete the audit in Report 1.
coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b-a22b-2507) failed to review the PKGBUILD due to an API error (HTTP 400, BadRequestError), leaving the most critical file unaudited.
learnings: Tool errors (API failures) should trigger automatic retries or fallback to another model to ensure critical files like PKGBUILD are always reviewed, rather than marking the entire audit as inconclusive.
The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool error' and 'inconclusive due to genuine uncertainty' to avoid unnecessary escalations.
